stops.name: Große Dolomitenstraße
stops.detail: The Great Dolomites Road was the first holiday road for the development of the Dolomites, which was opened on 13 September 1909. It is 109 km long and crosses the Dolomites in a west-east direction from Bolzano to Cortina d’Ampezzo.
